title: The Mistakes Erased Gently
youtube_title: The Mistakes Erased Gently | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Remembering a kindness is a way of returning it.
summary: At a harbor shelter on the lee side of the wind, Pema notices that Neighbor Sami has already taken care of a pencil line erased gently so the paper did not roughen. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Pema does one useful thing Neighbor Sami did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
